messages:
Casey M.: Quick ask 11 PR #4401 updates the migration examples and fixes a few anchors. Need one prose reviewer and one code reviewer. Prefer merge in tonight's 20:00 PT quick window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4401

Jordan L.: I can take the TypeScript snippet review and run it locally. If the test harness is flaky I can convert it to a small mocked unit test.

Ava R.: I'll do prose + linkcheck. Heads-up: I'm on a call 19:30-20:30 PT, so I can approve but won't be able to merge.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4401 (status: failing linkcheck: 2 broken anchors)

Casey M.: The anchors are in migration/notes.md (#breaking-changes) and examples/quickstart.md (old auth anchor). I pushed anchor fixes but haven't retriggered CI. Jordan 44b can you hold the merge if CI looks good?

Jordan L.: I'll run the snippet and re-run linkcheck after Casey's push. If CI turns green I'll merge in the 20:00 slot since Ava is on-call but busy.

Ava R.: Thanks Jordan. If you merge, can you also add a one-line ownership note in docs/OWNERSHIP.md under "small-fixes" so these quick link-only PRs get triaged faster next time? I'll raise the automation issue tomorrow.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4401 (status: passing)

Jordan L.: Reviewed, left one tiny nit about an inline code example style. Approved. Merging now for 20:00 PT window. Will follow up with the one-line ownership update post-merge.

Casey M.: Appreciate it 44aa. I'll watch the post-merge preview for redirects. If anything breaks I'll open a follow-up PR.

Ava R.: Thanks everyone 44af. Nice coordinated handoff.
